Supporting every level and discipline

Our programmes translate research into action, strengthening every layer of India's sporting ecosystem. Through targeted interventions, we enable academies, coaches, athletes, institutions, and communities to deliver sustained impact.

Level of competition

Olympic Games

Athletes from structured high-performance pathways have represented India on the world's most demanding stage.

Paralympic Games

Integrated performance support systems have helped para-athletes deliver inspiring performances.

World Championships

Asian Games / Asian Para Games

Long-term development frameworks have driven podium success at the Asian Games and Asian Para Games.

Athlete selection process

A research-driven selection framework

We follow a transparent, multi-stage process to identify beneficiaries whose aspirations align with structured, long-term performance development.

Applications are opened and shared widely through GoSports' channels and partner networks so eligible individuals and organisations across the sporting ecosystem can apply.

Applications are reviewed against the programme's eligibility criteria to identify candidates for further evaluation.

Eligible beneficiaries are assessed against programme-specific criteria to understand their achievements, potential, and alignment with programme objectives.

The selection panel and programme partners review shortlisted beneficiaries and align on the next stage of assessment.

Independent experts bring technical expertise and domain knowledge to strengthen the evaluation process.

Detailed beneficiary profiles are compiled to enable informed, meaningful interactions during selection.

Shortlisted beneficiaries meet the selection panel, who assess aspirations, commitment, mindset, and long-term vision.

A comprehensive review of each shortlisted beneficiary's context, support ecosystem, and development needs before final selection.

Successful beneficiaries are selected based on the overall evaluation and formally onboarded to begin their development journey.
